description: Triage: phan loai issues theo severity + fixability + domain. Tao bug-triage.md, fix-plan.md, enrich issue-registry.json, init fix-log.json, phase-summary.md. Nhan issue-registry.json (initial) tu wf-fix-bugs Lane Dispatch, chuan bi input cho wf-fix-execute. v1.4.0: dong bo version voi SKILL.md, schema-sync-triage compliance (write_role di chuyen vao registry_scope theo template). v1.3.0: cap nhat session_dir_variants sang v7.0 flat format. v1.2 (S3 wf-fix-bugs v7.0): fix-plan.md + fix-log.json templates di chuyen sang _shared/lane/templates/ (fix F3 cross-skill template fragility).

prerequisites.notes: v7.0 canonical: session_id = YYYY-MM-DD-{scope}-{slug}-{NN}, flat structure, KHONG nesting sessions/{sys}/{mod}/ nhu v6.x. Xem wf-fix-bugs/procedures/session-dir.md §v7.0 Session ID Format. $SESSION_DIR duoc resolve boi wf-fix-bugs Lane Dispatch (Phase 0). Orchestrator resolve $SESSION_DIR bang find -maxdepth 2 tren sessions/. phases.phase_1.status == 'completed' (Lane Dispatch da xong) + phases.phase_2.status != 'completed' (chua triage). issue-registry.json PHAI co issues. v6 mode: detect via fix-status.json.engine_version == 'v6' — fallback path run-NNN--YYYYMMDD/, triage van enrich severity/fixability binh thuong.

inputs.name: fix-status-path
inputs.description: Path to $SESSION_DIR/fix-status.json. Contains session config, scope, flags, phase 1 results.

inputs.name: issue-registry-path
inputs.description: Path to $SESSION_DIR/issue-registry.json. Initial list (severity/fixability/domain CHUA set) — wf-fix-triage se enrich.

working.notes: Bug triage report — severity counts + issue tables + execution plan. Tao o Step 2.3.

Canonical template (Sprint 3 F07.010). fix-plan.md la input cua wf-fix-execute. v10 concise (36 dòng) — agent fill chi tiết khi spawn. READ template → FILL data → WRITE vao $SESSION_DIR/fix-plan.md. Tao o Step 2.3a. Validator resolve: $SKILLS_DIR/wf-fix-triage/../wf-fix-bugs/templates/phase5-triage/fix-plan.md. Legacy v7 320-line template archived to _shared/lane/templates/archive/fix-plan-v7-legacy.md.
UPDATE (KHONG CREATE) — enrich severity/batch/fixability/domain. File da ton tai (boi wf-fix-bugs Lane Dispatch). Giu nguyen cac fields khac. Step 2.3b.

Canonical template (Sprint 3 XF-03). fix-log.json schema fix-log-v2 — init by wf-fix-triage Step 2.3c, APPEND by wf-fix-execute Phase 3. Validator resolve: $SKILLS_DIR/wf-fix-triage/../wf-fix-bugs/templates/phase5-triage/fix-log.json. Legacy v1 template archived to _shared/lane/templates/archive/fix-log-v1.json.

CORE-028 + Protocol 14: Phase summary tieng Viet, <=15 dong, non-technical. Inline template (xem SKILL.md §Phase 2 Step 2.8). Sub-skill cua wf-fix-bugs orchestrator ghi vao $SESSION_DIR (shared session dir), overwrite summary cua phase truoc. Tao o Step 2.8 sau khi POST-GATE structural checks pass. Neu POST-GATE fail 3 iterations: VAN tao voi status 'THAT BAI'.

registry_scope.notes: wf-fix-triage KHONG ghi vao req-registry.json. Chi wf-fix-execute (Phase 4) co quyen update impl_status.

cross_skill_contracts._profile_count_note: producers_count va consumers_count tinh theo DATA FLOW: wf-fix-bugs Lane Dispatch produces input data, wf-fix-execute consumes output data. spawned_by/returns_to chi dinh ORCHESTRATOR relationship (wf-fix-bugs dieu phoi).

returns_to.via: fix-status.json active_skill field update (active_skill='wf-fix-bugs', next_action='phase_3_execute' — orchestrator luon spawn wf-fix-execute; execute tu detect flags.dry_run de skip Phase 3-5 khi can)

uses_templates_from.rationale: S3 (wf-fix-bugs v7.0) — fix-plan.md + fix-log.json la cross-skill artifacts (consume boi wf-fix-execute), di chuyen sang _shared/lane/templates/ de tranh fragile relative path. F3 fix.

code_intelligence.pattern: PRE-GATE detection (Na/Nb/Nc) + CI-ROUTE Phase 2 bug investigation (phase2-triage.md)
ci_tasks: understand_flow (Phase 2: GitNexus query de tim execution flows lien quan den bug)
find_definition (Phase 2: Serena find_definition de xac dinh vi tri suspected function)
symbol_overview (Phase 2: Serena get_symbols_overview de hieu cau truc file)
code_intelligence.graceful_degradation: Lock held → fallback Grep. Tool unavailable → fallback Grep/Read. Freshness caveat → warning. Zero regression.
code_intelligence.notes: CI tools duoc auto-detect o Phase 0 PRE-GATE. Neu spawned boi orchestrator (wf-fix-bugs), nhan CI context tu orchestrator; neu standalone --resume, tu detect.
